v.t: Ta, Seen. These are the Signs of the Quran—a book that makes things clear
v.l: Ta-Sin Tilka 'Ayatu Al-Qur'ani Wa Kitabin Mubinin

v.t: Guidance and good news for the believers
v.l: Hudaan Wa Bushra Lilmu'uminina

v.t: Those who observe the prayers, and give charity regularly, and are certain of the Hereafter
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yuqimuna As-Salaata Wa Yu'utuna Az-Zakaata Wa Hum Bil-'Akhirati Hum Yuqinuna

v.t: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter: We made their deeds appear good to them, so they wander aimlessly
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati Zayyanna Lahum 'A`malahum Fahum Ya`mahuna

v.t: It is they who will receive the grievous punishment—and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Lahum Su'u Al-`Adhabi Wa Hum Fi Al-'Akhirati Humu Al-'Akhsaruna

v.t: You are receiving the Quran from an All-Wise, All-Knowing
v.l: Wa 'Innaka Latulaqqa Al-Qur'ana Min Ladun Hakimin `Alimin

v.t: When Moses said to his family, “I have glimpsed a fire. I will bring you some news from it; or bring you a firebrand, that you may warm yourselves.”
v.l: Idh Qala Musa Li'hlihi 'Inni 'Anastu Naraan Sa'atikum Minha Bikhabarin 'Aw 'Atikum Bishihabin Qabasin La`allakum Tastaluna

v.t: Then, when he reached it, he was called: “Blessed is He who is within the fire, and He who is around it, and glorified be God, Lord of the Worlds
v.l: Falamma Ja'aha Nudiya 'An Burika Man Fi An-Nari Wa Man Hawlaha Wa Subhana Allahi Rabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: O Moses, it is I, God, the Almighty, the Wise
v.l: Ya Musa 'Innahu 'Ana Allahu Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: Throw down your staff.” But when he saw it quivering, as though it were a demon, he turned around not looking back. “O Moses, do not fear; the messengers do not fear in My presence
v.l: Wa 'Alqi `Asaka Falamma Ra'aha Tahtazzu Ka'annaha Jannun Walla Mudbiraan Wa Lam Yu`aqqib Ya Musa La Takhaf 'Inni La Yakhafu Ladayya Al-Mursaluna

v.t: But whoever has done wrong, and then substituted goodness in place of evil. I am Forgiving and Merciful
v.l: Illa Man Zalama Thumma Baddala Husnaan Ba`da Su'in Fa'inni Ghafurun Rahimun

v.t: Put your hand inside your pocket, and it will come out white, without blemish—among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people, for they are immoral people.”
v.l: Wa 'Adkhil Yadaka Fi Jaybika Takhruj Bayđa'a Min Ghayri Su'in Fi Tis`i 'Ayatin 'Ila Fir`awna Wa Qawmihi 'Innahum Kanu Qawmaan Fasiqina

v.t: Yet when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, “This is obvious witchcraft.”
v.l: Falamma Ja'at/hum 'Ayatuna Mubsiratan Qalu Hadha Sihrun Mubinun

v.t: And they rejected them, although their souls were certain of them, out of wickedness and pride. So see how the outcome was for the mischief-makers
v.l: Wa Jahadu Biha Wa Astayqanat/ha 'Anfusuhum Zulmaan Wa `Uluwaan Fanzur Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Mufsidina

v.t: And We gave David and Solomon knowledge. They said, “Praise God, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Dawuda Wa Sulaymana `Ilmaan Wa Qala Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi Fađđalana `Ala Kathirin Min `Ibadihi Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: And Solomon succeeded David. He said, “O people, we were taught the language of birds, and we were given from everything. This is indeed a real blessing.”
v.l: Wa Waritha Sulaymanu Dawuda Wa Qala Ya 'Ayyuha An-Nasu `Ullimna Mantiqa At-Tayri Wa 'Utina Min Kulli Shay'in 'Inna Hadha Lahuwa Al-Fađlu Al-Mubinu

v.t: To the service of Solomon were mobilized his troops of sprites, and men, and birds—all held in strict order
v.l: Wa Hushira Lisulaymana Junuduhu Mina Al-Jinni Wa Al-'Insi Wa At-Tayri Fahum Yuza`una

v.t: Until, when they came upon the Valley of Ants, an ant said, “O ants! Go into your nests, lest Solomon and his troops crush you without noticing.”
v.l: Hatta 'Idha 'Ataw `Ala Wadi An-Namli Qalat Namlatun Ya 'Ayyuha An-Namlu Adkhulu Masakinakum La Yahtimannakum Sulaymanu Wa Junuduhu Wa Hum La Yash`uruna

v.t: He smiled and laughed at her words, and said, “My Lord, direct me to be thankful for the blessings you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good works that please You. And admit me, by Your grace, into the company of Your virtuous servants.”
v.l: Fatabassama Đahikaan Min Qawliha Wa Qala Rabbi 'Awzi`ni 'An 'Ashkura Ni`mataka Allati 'An`amta `Alayya Wa `Ala Wa Lidayya Wa 'An 'A`mala Salihaan Tarđahu Wa 'Adkhilni Birahmatika Fi `Ibadika As-Salihina

v.t: Then he inspected the birds, and said, “Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees
v.l: Wa Tafaqqada At-Tayra Faqala Ma Li La 'Ara Al-Hud/huda 'Am Kana Mina Al-Gha'ibina

v.t: I will punish him most severely, or slay him, unless he gives me a valid excuse.”
v.l: La'u`adhibannahu `Adhabaan Shadidaan 'Aw La'adhbahannahu 'Aw Laya'tiyani Bisultanin Mubinin

v.t: But he did not stay for long. He said, “I have learnt something you did not know. I have come to you from Sheba, with reliable information
v.l: Famakatha Ghayra Ba`idin Faqala 'Ahattu Bima Lam Tuhit Bihi Wa Ji'tuka Min Saba'iin Binaba'iin Yaqinin
w: and I have come to you

v.t: I found a woman ruling over them, and she was given of everything, and she has a magnificent throne
v.l: Inni Wa Jadttu Amra'atan Tamlikuhum Wa 'Utiyat Min Kulli Shay'in Wa Laha `Arshun `Azimun

v.t: I found her and her people worshiping the sun, instead of God. Satan made their conduct appear good to them, and diverted them from the path, so they are not guided
v.l: Wa Jadtuha Wa Qawmaha Yasjuduna Lilshamsi Min Duni Allahi Wa Zayyana Lahumu Ash-Shaytanu 'A`malahum Fasaddahum `Ani As-Sabili Fahum La Yahtaduna

v.t: If only they would worship God, who brings to light the mysteries of the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal
v.l: Alla Yasjudu Lillahi Al-Ladhi Yukhriju Al-Khab'a Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Ya`lamu Ma Tukhfuna Wa Ma Tu`linuna

v.t: God—There is no god but He, the Lord of the Sublime Throne.”
v.l: Allahu La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Rabbu Al-`Arshi Al-`Azimi

v.t: He said, “We will see, whether you have spoken the truth, or whether you are a liar
v.l: Qala Sananzuru 'Asadaqta 'Am Kunta Mina Al-Kadhibina

v.t: Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them; then withdraw from them, and see how they respond.”
v.l: Adh/hab Bikitabi Hadha Fa'alqih 'Ilayhim Thumma Tawalla `Anhum Fanzur Madha Yarji`una

v.t: She said, “O Counselors, a gracious letter was delivered to me
v.l: Qalat Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Mala'u 'Inni 'Ulqiya 'Ilayya Kitabun Karimun

v.t: It is from Solomon, and it is, ‘In the Name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful
v.l: Innahu Min Sulaymana Wa 'Innahu Bismi Allahi Ar-Rahmani Ar-Rahimi

v.t: Do not defy me, and come to me submissively.’”
v.l: Alla Ta`lu `Alayya Wa 'Tuni Muslimina

v.t: She said, “O counselors, advise me in this matter of mine. I never make a decision unless you are present.”
v.l: Qalat Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Mala'u 'Aftuni Fi 'Amri Ma Kuntu Qati`atan 'Amraan Hatta Tash/haduni

v.t: They said, “We are a people of might and great courage, but the decision is yours, so consider what you wish to command.”
v.l: Qalu Nahnu 'Ulu Quwatin Wa 'Ulu Ba'sin Shadidin Wa Al-'Amru 'Ilayki Fanzuri Madha Ta'murina

v.t: She said, “When kings enter a city, they devastate it, and subjugate its dignified people. Thus they always do
v.l: Qalat 'Inna Al-Muluka 'Idha Dakhalu Qaryatan 'Afsaduha Wa Ja`alu 'A`izzata 'Ahliha 'Adhillatan Wa Kadhalika Yaf`aluna

v.t: I am sending them a gift, and will see what the envoys bring back.”
v.l: Wa 'Inni Mursilatun 'Ilayhim Bihadiyatin Fanaziratun Bima Yarji`u Al-Mursaluna

v.t: When he came to Solomon, he said, “Are you supplying me with money? What God has given me is better than what He has given you. It is you who delight in your gift
v.l: Falamma Ja'a Sulaymana Qala 'Atumiddunani Bimalin Fama 'Ataniya Allahu Khayrun Mimma 'Atakum Bal 'Antum Bihadiyatikum Tafrahuna

v.t: Go back to them. We will come upon them with troops they cannot resist; and we will expel them from there, disgraced and humiliated.”
v.l: Arji` 'Ilayhim Falana'tiyannahum Bijunudin La Qibala Lahum Biha Wa Lanukhrijannahum Minha 'Adhillatan Wa Hum Saghiruna
w: surely, we will come to them
and surely, we will drive them out

v.t: He said, “O notables, which one of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?”
v.l: Qala Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Mala'u 'Ayyukum Ya'tini Bi`arshiha Qabla 'An Ya'tuni Muslimina

v.t: An imp of the sprites said, “I will bring it to you before you rise from your seat. I am strong and reliable enough to do it.”
v.l: Qala `Ifrytun Mina Al-Jinni 'Ana 'Atika Bihi Qabla 'An Taquma Min Maqamika Wa 'Inni `Alayhi Laqawiyun 'Aminun

v.t: He who had knowledge from the Book said, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” And when he saw it settled before him, he said, “This is from the grace of my Lord, to test me, whether I am grateful or ungrateful. He who is grateful, his gratitude is to his own credit; but he who is ungrateful—my Lord is Independent and Generous.”
v.l: Qala Al-Ladhi `Indahu `Ilmun Mina Al-Kitabi 'Ana 'Atika Bihi Qabla 'An Yartadda 'Ilayka Tarfuka Falamma Ra'ahu Mustaqirraan `Indahu Qala Hadha Min Fađli Rabbi Liyabluwani 'A'ashkuru 'Am 'Akfuru Wa Man Shakara Fa'innama Yashkuru Linafsihi Wa Man Kafara Fa'inna Rabbi Ghaniyun Karimun

v.t: He said, “Disguise her throne for her, and we shall see whether she will be guided, or remains one of the misguided.”
v.l: Qala Nakkiru Laha `Arshaha Nanzur 'Atahtadi 'Am Takunu Mina Al-Ladhina La Yahtaduna

v.t: When she arrived, it was said, “Is your throne like this?” She said, “As if this is it.” “We were given knowledge before her, and we were submissive.”
v.l: Falamma Ja'at Qila 'Ahakadha `Arshuki Qalat Ka'annahu Huwa Wa 'Utina Al-`Ilma Min Qabliha Wa Kunna Muslimina

v.t: But she was prevented by what she worshiped besides God; she belonged to a disbelieving people
v.l: Wa Saddaha Ma Kanat Ta`budu Min Duni Allahi 'Innaha Kanat Min Qawmin Kafirina

v.t: It was said to her, “Go inside the palace.” And when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pond, and she bared her legs. He said, “It is a palace paved with glass.” She said, “My Lord, I have done wrong to myself, and I have submitted with Solomon, to God, Lord of the Worlds.”
v.l: Qila Laha Adkhuli As-Sarha Falamma Ra'at/hu Hasibat/hu Lujjatan Wa Kashafat `An Saqayha Qala 'Innahu Sarhun Mumarradun Min Qawarira Qalat Rabbi 'Inni Zalamtu Nafsi Wa 'Aslamtu Ma`a Sulaymana Lillahi Rabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: And We sent to Thamood their brother Saleh: “Worship God.” But they became two disputing factions
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna 'Ila Thamuda 'Akhahum Salihaan 'Ani A`budu Allaha Fa'idha Hum Fariqani Yakhtasimuna

v.t: He said, “O my people, why are you quick to do evil rather than good? If only you would seek God’s forgiveness, so that you may be shown mercy.”
v.l: Qala Ya Qawmi Lima Tasta`jiluna Bis-Sayyi'ati Qabla Al-Hasanati Lawla Tastaghfiruna Allaha La`allakum Turhamuna

v.t: They said, “We consider you an ill omen, and those with you.” He said, “Your omen is with God. In fact, you are a people being tested.”
v.l: Qalu Attayyarna Bika Wa Biman Ma`aka Qala Ta'irukum `Inda Allahi Bal 'Antum Qawmun Tuftanuna
w: We consider you a bad omen
We consider you a bad omen

v.t: In the city was a gang of nine who made mischief in the land and did no good
v.l: Wa Kana Fi Al-Madinati Tis`atu Rahtin Yufsiduna Fi Al-'Arđi Wa La Yuslihuna

v.t: They said, “Swear by God to one another that we will attack him and his family by night, and then tell his guardian, 'We did not witness the murder of his family, and we are being truthful.'“
v.l: Qalu Taqasamu Billahi Lanubayyitannahu Wa 'Ahlahu Thumma Lanaqulanna Liwaliyihi Ma Shahidna Mahlika 'Ahlihi Wa 'Inna Lasadiquna
w: surely, we will attack him by night

v.t: They planned a plan, and We planned a plan, but they did not notice
v.l: Wa Makaru Makraan Wa Makarna Makraan Wa Hum La Yash`uruna

v.t: So note the outcome of their planning; We destroyed them and their people, altogether
v.l: Fanzur Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Makrihim 'Anna Dammarnahum Wa Qawmahum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: Here are their homes, in ruins, on account of their iniquities. Surely in this is a sign for people who know
v.l: Fatilka Buyutuhum Khawiyatan Bima Zalamu 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Liqawmin Ya`lamuna

v.t: And We saved those who believed and were pious
v.l: Wa 'Anjayna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa Kanu Yattaquna

v.t: And Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit lewdness with open eyes
v.l: Wa Lutaan 'Idh Qala Liqawmihi 'Ata'tuna Al-Fahishata Wa 'Antum Tubsiruna

v.t: Do you lust after men instead of women? You are truly ignorant people.”
v.l: A'innakum Lata'tuna Ar-Rijala Shahwatan Min Duni An-Nisa' Bal 'Antum Qawmun Tajhaluna

v.t: But the only response of his people was to say, “Expel the family of Lot from your town. They are purist people.”
v.l: Fama Kana Jawaba Qawmihi 'Illa 'An Qalu 'Akhriju 'Ala Lutin Min Qaryatikum 'Innahum 'Unasun Yatatahharuna

v.t: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife, whom We destined to be among the laggards
v.l: Fa'anjaynahu Wa 'Ahlahu 'Illa Amra'atahu Qaddarnaha Mina Al-Ghabirina

v.t: And We rained upon them a rain. Miserable was the rain of those forewarned
v.l: Wa 'Amtarna `Alayhim Mataraan Fasa'a Mataru Al-Mundharina

v.t: Say, “Praise God, and peace be upon His servants whom He has selected. Is God better, or what they associate?”
v.l: Quli Al-Hamdu Lillahi Wa Salamun `Ala `Ibadihi Al-Ladhina Astafa 'Aalllahu Khayrun 'Amma Yushrikuna

v.t: Or, who created the heavens and the earth, and rains down water from the sky for you? With it We produce gardens full of beauty, whose trees you could not have produced. Is there another god with God? But they are a people who equate
v.l: Amman Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa 'Anzala Lakum Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'anbatna Bihi Hada'iqa Dhata Bahjatin Ma Kana Lakum 'An Tunbitu Shajaraha 'A'ilahun Ma`a Allahi Bal Hum Qawmun Ya`diluna

v.t: Or, who made the earth habitable, and made rivers flow through it, and set mountains on it, and placed a partition between the two seas? Is there another god with God? But most of them do not know
v.l: Amman Ja`ala Al-'Arđa Qararaan Wa Ja`ala Khilalaha 'Anharaan Wa Ja`ala Laha Rawasiya Wa Ja`ala Bayna Al-Bahrayni Hajizaan 'A'ilahun Ma`a Allahi Bal 'Aktharuhum La Ya`lamuna

v.t: Or, who answers the one in need when he prays to Him, and relieves adversity, and makes you successors on earth? Is there another god with God? How hardly you pay attention
v.l: Amman Yujibu Al-Muđtarra 'Idha Da`ahu Wa Yakshifu As-Su'a Wa Yaj`alukum Khulafa'a Al-'Arđi 'A'ilahun Ma`a Allahi Qalilaan Ma Tadhakkaruna

v.t: Or, who guides you through the darkness of land and sea, and who sends the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there another god with God? Most exalted is God, above what they associate
v.l: Amman Yahdikum Fi Zulumati Al-Barri Wa Al-Bahri Wa Man Yursilu Ar-Riyaha Bushraan Bayna Yaday Rahmatihi 'A'ilahun Ma`a Allahi Ta`ala Allahu `Amma Yushrikuna

v.t: Or, who originates the creation and then repeats it, and who gives you livelihood from the sky and the earth? Is there another god with God? Say, “Produce your evidence, if you are truthful.”
v.l: Amman Yabda'u Al-Khalqa Thumma Yu`iduhu Wa Man Yarzuqukum Mina As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi 'A'ilahun Ma`a Allahi Qul Hatu Burhanakum 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: Say, “No one in the heavens or on earth knows the future except God; and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.”
v.l: Qul La Ya`lamu Man Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Al-Ghayba 'Illa Allahu Wa Ma Yash`uruna 'Ayyana Yub`athuna

v.t: In fact, their knowledge of the Hereafter is confused. In fact, they are in doubt about it. In fact, they are blind to it
v.l: Bal Addaraka `Ilmuhum Fi Al-'Akhirati Bal Hum Fi Shakkin Minha Bal Hum Minha `Amuna

v.t: Those who disbelieve say, “When we have become dust, and our ancestors, shall we be brought out
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'A'idha Kunna Turabaan Wa 'Aba'uuna 'A'inna Lamukhrajuna

v.t: We were promised that before, we and our ancestors—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
v.l: Laqad Wu`idna Hadha Nahnu Wa 'Aba'uuna Min Qablu 'In Hadha 'Illa 'Asatiru Al-'Awwalina

v.t: Say, travel through the earth, and observe the fate of the guilty.”
v.l: Qul Siru Fi Al-'Arđi Fanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Mujrimina

v.t: But do not grieve over them, and do not be troubled by what they plot
v.l: Wa La Tahzan `Alayhim Wa La Takun Fi Đayqin Mimma Yamkuruna

v.t: And they say, “When is this promise, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Mata Hadha Al-Wa`du 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: Say, “Perhaps some of what you are impatient for has drawn near.”
v.l: Qul `Asa 'An Yakuna Radifa Lakum Ba`đu Al-Ladhi Tasta`jiluna

v.t: Your Lord is gracious towards humanity, but most of them are not thankful
v.l: Wa 'Inna Rabbaka Ladhu Fađlin `Ala An-Nasi Wa Lakinna 'Aktharahum La Yashkuruna

v.t: And your Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they reveal
v.l: Wa 'Inna Rabbaka Laya`lamu Ma Tukinnu Suduruhum Wa Ma Yu`linuna

v.t: There is no mystery in the heaven and the earth, but it is in a Clear Book
v.l: Wa Ma Min Gha'ibatin Fi As-Sama'i Wa Al-'Arđi 'Illa Fi Kitabin Mubinin

v.t: This Quran relates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about
v.l: Inna Hadha Al-Qur'ana Yaqussu `Ala Bani 'Isra'ila 'Akthara Al-Ladhi Hum Fihi Yakhtalifuna

v.t: And it is guidance and mercy for the believers
v.l: Wa 'Innahu Lahudaan Wa Rahmatun Lilmu'uminina

v.t: Your Lord will judge between them by His wisdom. He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing
v.l: Inna Rabbaka Yaqđi Baynahum Bihukmihi Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-`Alimu

v.t: So rely on God. You are upon the clear truth
v.l: Fatawakkal `Ala Allahi 'Innaka `Ala Al-Haqqi Al-Mubini

v.t: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call if they turn their backs and flee
v.l: Innaka La Tusmi`u Al-Mawta Wa La Tusmi`u As-Summa Ad-Du`a'a 'Idha Wa Llaw Mudbirina

v.t: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can make no one listen, except those who believe in Our verses; for they are Muslims
v.l: Wa Ma 'Anta Bihadi Al-`Umyi `An Đalalatihim 'In Tusmi`u 'Illa Man Yu'uminu Bi'ayatina Fahum Muslimuna

v.t: And when the Word has fallen on them, We will bring out for them from the earth a creature which will say to them that the people are uncertain of Our revelations
v.l: Wa 'Idha Waqa`a Al-Qawlu `Alayhim 'Akhrajna Lahum Dabbatan Mina Al-'Arđi Tukallimuhum 'Anna An-Nasa Kanu Bi'ayatina La Yuqinuna

v.t: On the Day when We gather from every community a group of those who rejected Our revelations; and they will be restrained
v.l: Wa Yawma Nahshuru Min Kulli 'Ummatin Fawjaan Mimman Yukadhibu Bi'ayatina Fahum Yuza`una

v.t: Until, when they arrive, He will say, “Did you reject My revelations without comprehending them? Or what is it you were doing?”
v.l: Hatta 'Idha Ja'u Qala 'Akadhabtum Bi'ayati Wa Lam Tuhitu Biha `Ilmaan 'Ammadha Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: The Word will come down upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak
v.l: Wa Waqa`a Al-Qawlu `Alayhim Bima Zalamu Fahum La Yantiquna

v.t: Do they not see that We made the night for them to rest therein, and the day for visibility? Surely in that are signs for people who believe
v.l: Alam Yaraw 'Anna Ja`alna Al-Layla Liyaskunu Fihi Wa An-Nahara Mubsiraan 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Yu'uminuna

v.t: On the Day when the Trumpet is blown, everyone in the heavens and the earth will be horrified, except whomever God wills; and everyone will come before Him in humility
v.l: Wa Yawma Yunfakhu Fi As-Suri Fafazi`a Man Fi As-Samawati Wa Man Fi Al-'Arđi 'Illa Man Sha'a Allahu Wa Kullun 'Atawhu Dakhirina

v.t: And you see the mountains, and imagine them fixed, yet they pass, as the passing of the clouds—the making of God, who has perfected everything. He is fully Informed of what you do
v.l: Wa Tara Al-Jibala Tahsabuha Jamidatan Wa Hiya Tamurru Marra As-Sahabi Sun`a Allahi Al-Ladhi 'Atqana Kulla Shay'in 'Innahu Khabirun Bima Taf`aluna

v.t: Whoever brings a virtue will receive better than it—and they will be safe from the horrors of that Day
v.l: Man Ja'a Bil-Hasanati Falahu Khayrun Minha Wa Hum Min Faza`in Yawma'idhin 'Aminuna

v.t: But whoever brings evil—their faces will be tumbled into the Fire. Will you be rewarded except for what you used to do
v.l: Wa Man Ja'a Bis-Sayyi'ati Fakubbat Wujuhuhum Fi An-Nari Hal Tujzawna 'Illa Ma Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: “I was commanded to worship the Lord of this town, who has sanctified it, and to Whom everything belongs; and I was commanded to be of those who submit
v.l: Innama 'Umirtu 'An 'A`buda Rabba Hadhihi Al-Baldati Al-Ladhi Harramaha Wa Lahu Kullu Shay'in Wa 'Umirtu 'An 'Akuna Mina Al-Muslimina

v.t: And to recite the Quran.” Whoever is guided—is guided to his own advantage. And whoever goes astray, then say, “I am one of the warners.”
v.l: Wa 'An 'Atluwa Al-Qur'ana Famani Ahtada Fa'innama Yahtadi Linafsihi Wa Man Đalla Faqul 'Innama 'Ana Mina Al-Mundhirina

v.t: And say, “Praise belongs to God; He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. Your Lord is not heedless of what you do.”
v.l: Wa Quli Al-Hamdu Lillahi Sayurikum 'Ayatihi Fata`rifunaha Wa Ma Rabbuka Bighafilin `Amma Ta`maluna
